Archival Dispatch: 20 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Louisiana Hayride, AFVN Saigon, and Ellery Queen's Minute Mysteries

Batch 52 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 52 resolves 20 historic radio broadcasts across Shreveport country-music history, Vietnam War military broadcasting, and syndication detective puzzles: 8 live stage recordings from the legendary Louisiana Hayride (1954–1971, broadcast over KWKH Shreveport featuring Skeeter Davis, Nat Stuckey, Billy Walker, and Margie Singleton), 7 wartime radio transmissions from the American Forces Vietnam Network (AFVN Saigon & Da Nang) (1968–1972, including Don Cotterell's country morning show, the Halloween Neewollah Hour, and Johnny Mathis AFRTS showcases), and 5 syndicated 1949 riddle-drama episodes of Ellery Queen's Minute Mysteries.

1. Louisiana Hayride — 1954–1971 KWKH Shreveport Live Stage Broadcasts

"The Cradle of Stars" originating live from Shreveport's Municipal Memorial Auditorium:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Performer & Live Selection
Hayride_Billy_Walker_Talk_Me_Out.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Billy Walker - 'You Can Talk Me Out of Anything But Love'" 1954-08-28 The 'Traveling Texan' in an early breakout country stage performance.
Hayride_Skeeter_Davis_House.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Skeeter Davis - 'I Don't Wanna Play House'" 1967-11-18 Skeeter Davis performs her poignant Grammy-nominated country hit live.
Hayride_Bill_Carlisle_Deal.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Bill Carlisle - 'What Kind of Deal Is This'" 1965-03-27 Grand Ole Opry and Hayride comedy superstar's novelty showpiece.
Hayride_Nat_Stuckey_Jambalaya.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Nat Stuckey - 'Jambalaya (On the Bayou)'" 1966-07-09 Louisiana native Nat Stuckey performs Hank Williams' Cajun anthem.
Hayride_Margie_Singleton_Waltz.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Margie Singleton - 'Waltz of the Angels'" 1960-04-16 Shreveport local favorite's emotional country waltz performance.
Hayride_Linda_Davis_Country_Roads.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Linda Davis - 'Take Me Home, Country Roads'" 1971-09-11 Soulful live adaptation of John Denver's 1971 mountain classic.
Hayride_Frankie_Miller_Black_Land.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Frankie Miller - 'Black Land Farmer'" 1959-10-24 Miller's signature hard-honky-tonk anthem performed for the Shreveport crowd.
Hayride_Werley_Fairburn_Rockin.mp3 "Louisiana Hayride: Werley Fairburn - 'Everybody's Rockin''" 1956-02-18 High-octane rockabilly classic by the 'Singing Barber'.
